text: APPROVE: Moving the applier registration into `RegisterApplier` removes the nested ternary, the `if`, and the lambda nesting from `BuildPlan`, which should bring it under 15. Behaviour is preserved because `continue` at the end of the branch becomes an equivalent `return`, and dropping the `m` copy is safe since `foreach` captures a fresh `method` per iteration. I couldn't confirm that the `appliers` dictionary type in the helper signature matches the declared type in the rest of the file, or measure the new complexity score, so the build and threshold claims rest on reading the diff alone.
